messages:
allhands-bot: Opening a focused follow-up thread for leadership Qs from today. Keep it short or flag for a 1:1.
jamie_ceo: Quick note: answering the high-level ones here, we'll stitch a short public FAQ after.
noel_sales: Customers keep asking for a single-sentence reason to pick Redwood vs hyperscalers. Need a tight line for decks.
jamie_ceo: Try: "Redwood makes LLM features predictable in cost and latency across hosted, reserved, and private installs — so you can ship fast and scale without surprises." Feedback welcome.
mika_growth: Can we quantify "predictable"? Some customers want p99 numbers and cost per 1k tokens examples.
olivia_cto: We'll publish verified perf profiles per model class + common seq lengths. Will include p50/p95/p99 and a cost-per-1k example for typical configs.
priya_research: On positioning: should we lean into "serving as the moat" messaging publicly, or keep that as a sales play?
jamie_ceo: Publicly, be concrete: highlight what we do (routing, KV caching, rollout controls, SLO-backed tiers). Save the full thesis for deeper conversations.
devon_engineer: Ops question: how do we handle customer questions about observability retention and cost trade-offs?
nana_ops: For Dedicated/Private, we offer retention tiers; default is 30d. We can increase retention as an add-on. Publish table in docs with prices.
noel_sales: Competitors tout proprietary models as lock-in. Do we push back on that?
jamie_ceo: Don't attack. Instead, show migration stories, open benchmarks, and a model provenance checklist. Transparency beats hyperbole.
mika_growth: Request: marketing needs 3 short lines for Hosted / Dedicated / Private that are audience-specific (dev, infra, legal). Who owns?
jamie_ceo: Mika + Noel own messaging. Olivia to provide 1-2 tech bullets per product. Priya will supply benchmark language. I'll review.
priya_research: Also recommend we release a small reproducible benchmark kit (not a full suite) so customers can validate perf in their envs.
olivia_cto: Agreed — OSS-friendly kit that runs sample workloads + KV cache toggles. It should make our routing and caching benefits obvious.
jamie_ceo: Action items: Mika/Noel (messaging), Olivia (perf kit + tech bullets), Ana (ops pricing table), Priya (bench language). Drafts by next Tue.
noel_sales: One more: migration incentives? discounts or credits to move from Hosted to Dedicated?
jamie_ceo: Keep it simple: first-year migration credits and step-up committed discounts (tiered). Finance will finalize thresholds.
allhands-bot: Thread will be closed after owners upload drafts.
